verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no first-party documentation describing Fly Postgres as fully-managed with point-in-time recovery, replicas, or built-in HA — the docs snippets focus on Sprites/Machines/agent hosting, not database management features. Community evidence actually references 'Postgres machines' but frames them as failure points ('poor support and unreliable infrastructure', databases going down) rather than confirming managed HA/PITR capabilities. Missing for 10: any documentation of PITR, read replicas, or automated failover/HA for Fly Postgres.
